title.fr: Ce que produit le Centre du Canada

text.en: Ontario and Quebec make most of the manufactured goods in Canada.
text.fr: L'Ontario et le Québec fabriquent la plupart des produits manufacturés du Canada.

source.quote: Together, Ontario and Quebec produce more than three-quarters of all Canadian manufactured goods

verification.evidence: Together, Ontario and Quebec produce more than three-quarters of all Canadian manufactured goods

text.en: Quebec has a huge supply of fresh water. Because of it, Quebec produces more hydro-electricity than any other province.
text.fr: Le Québec a d'énormes réserves d'eau douce. Grâce à elles, il produit plus d'hydroélectricité que toute autre province.

source.quote: The province’s huge supply of freshwater has made it Canada’s largest producer of hydro-electricity.

verification.evidence: Quebec is Canada’s main producer of pulp and paper. The province’s huge supply of freshwater has made it Canada’s largest producer of hydro-electricity.

text.en: Quebec is the main producer of pulp and paper in Canada.
text.fr: Le Québec est le principal producteur de pâtes et papiers au Canada.

source.quote: Quebec is Canada’s main producer of pulp and paper.

verification.evidence: Quebec is Canada’s main producer of pulp and paper.

text.en: Quebecers are leaders in new, advanced industries such as pharmaceuticals (medicines) and aeronautics (aircraft).
text.fr: Les Québécois sont des chefs de file dans des industries de pointe comme les produits pharmaceutiques et l'aéronautique.

source.quote: Quebecers are leaders in cutting-edge industries such as pharmaceuticals and aeronautics.

verification.evidence: Quebecers are leaders in cutting-edge industries such as pharmaceuticals and aeronautics.

text.en: Toronto is Canada's biggest city and its main centre for finance.
text.fr: Toronto est la plus grande ville du Canada et son principal centre financier.

source.quote: Toronto is the largest city in Canada and the country’s main financial centre

verification.evidence: Toronto is the largest city in Canada and the country’s main financial centre

text.en: In Ontario, many people work in service or manufacturing industries. These industries make a large share of what Canada exports.
text.fr: En Ontario, beaucoup de gens travaillent dans les industries de services ou de fabrication. Ces industries produisent une grande part des exportations du Canada.

source.quote: Many people work in the service or manufacturing industries, which produce a large percentage of Canada’s exports.

verification.evidence: Ontario … Toronto is the largest city in Canada and the country’s main financial centre. Many people work in the service or manufacturing industries, which produce a large percentage of Canada’s exports.

text.en: Farmers in Ontario raise dairy cattle, beef cattle and poultry, and they grow vegetables and grain.
text.fr: En Ontario, les agriculteurs élèvent des bovins laitiers, des bovins de boucherie et de la volaille, et ils cultivent des légumes et des céréales.

source.quote: Ontario farmers raise dairy and beef cattle, poultry, and vegetable and grain crops.

verification.evidence: Ontario farmers raise dairy and beef cattle, poultry, and vegetable and grain crops.
